name: Webwood Ichor
summary: Webwood Ichor is a fluid harvested from Webwood spiders prowling Teldrassil. Dirania Silveshine needs it, along with hyacinth mushrooms and moonpetal lilies, to brew an antidote for the poisoned Iverron.

sections.title: A Toxic Cure
sections.body: The Webwood spiders that haunt Shadowglen carry a venom dangerous enough to leave Iverron gravely ill. Dirania Silveshine asks for ichor from these spiders, along with hyacinth mushrooms and moonpetal lilies, to prepare an antidote.

faq.q: What is Webwood Ichor used for?
faq.answer: Dirania Silveshine in Shadowglen needs Webwood Ichor, hyacinth mushrooms, and moonpetal lilies to prepare an antidote for the poisoned night elf Iverron.

faq.q: Where does Webwood Ichor come from?
faq.answer: It is harvested from the corpses of Webwood Spiders residing in northwestern Shadowglen, particularly those dwelling around and inside Shadowthread Cave.

faq.q: Why use spider fluid to cure a spider bite?
faq.answer: Dirania requests Webwood Ichor as one of the ingredients for Iverron's antidote. She does not explain how the ichor works in the mixture.

angles.text: For young night elves defending Aldrassil, harvesting Webwood ichor teaches the harsh balance of nature: that the deadliest poisons of Teldrassil often harbor their own cures.
